When someone asks an AI tool "What's the best [your service]?", GEO helps make sure your business is part of the answer.

faq.title: SEO FAQs
faq.text: Clear answers to how modern SEO, GEO, and AEO integrate.

items.question: What are SEO services?
items.answer: SEO services improve your website's visibility in search engines so more of the right people find you. They include technical fixes, content, link building and local SEO. Our SEO services also cover AI search through GEO and AEO.

items.question: What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?
items.answer: GEO is the process of getting your brand mentioned and cited in AI-generated answers from tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Gemini. It focuses on authority, clear facts, brand mentions and content that AI models trust.

items.question: What is Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)?
items.answer: AEO optimizes your content to be the direct answer to a question, in featured snippets, People Also Ask boxes, voice assistants and AI answers. It uses clear, question-focused content and structured data.

items.question: Is SEO still worth it with AI search?
items.answer: Yes. AI tools rely heavily on well-ranked, trusted web content to generate answers. Strong SEO is the foundation for AI visibility. Businesses that combine SEO with GEO and AEO are best placed to win.

items.question: How long does SEO take to work?
items.answer: Technical fixes can show results within weeks. Content and authority usually take 3–6 months to build meaningful growth, depending on your competition and starting point.

items.question: Can you guarantee #1 rankings or AI citations?
items.answer: No, and be wary of anyone who does. No one controls Google or AI models. We guarantee clear work, transparent reporting and proven methods that consistently grow visibility.

items.question: How do you measure AI visibility?
items.answer: We regularly run a set of real buyer questions across major AI platforms and track how often your brand is mentioned, cited or recommended, compared with your competitors.

items.question: Do you offer local SEO?
items.answer: Yes. We optimize your Google Business Profile, local listings, reviews and location pages to help you rank in the map pack and local AI answers.
